common.preconditionHint: Write one sentence per line that is clearly true or false. Refer to another todo as #id, and if a command verifies it, put 'Check: <command>' on the next line. An #id condition clears itself once that todo is done. A single sentence the code cannot judge keeps the todo out of autorun.
